set.reason: The two endpoints substantially repeat the same sum/count procedure and average-level meaning. This is curricular review, not a substantive new content dependency between separate concepts.

set.reason: Signed rational addition is the operation needed to sum observations such as negative temperatures; the rejected mixed-power workflow is the wrong endpoint. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
set.scope: Summing rational-valued observations when computing their arithmetic mean

set.reason: The mean criterion divides the total by the count; it does not require powers or a complete mixed-power evaluation procedure. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
set.scope: Dividing the rational total by the positive observation count in an arithmetic mean

set.reason: Explaining weights changes how observations contribute to an average level; the ordinary mean supplies that averaging meaning, restricted to this interpretation component.
set.scope: weighted mean as generalization of arithmetic mean

set.reason: A quantified statement is judged true or false over its domain; proposition meaning is the relevant prerequisite, not necessary/sufficient-condition classification. set.scope: Determining truth of quantified propositions

set.reason: Subtracting the same real quantity preserves order, giving exactly the sign-of-difference criterion. This requires the common-addend order property, not mastery of all negative-multiplier transformations.

能正确计算两个有理数的和

能正确计算有理数除法

能由差的正负得出大小

set.name: Comparing Values by Subtraction

criteria: 能正确合并同类项
理解合并的依据是分配律
set.description: 同类项的系数相加，字母和字母的指数不变。
set.name: Combining Like Terms

criteria: 能判断变形后不等号是否要改向
能用性质比较两个数的大小
set.description: 会用不等式的基本性质：两边加同一个数、乘正数方向不变，乘负数方向改变。
set.name: Properties of Inequalities

criteria: 能说出平均数表示平均水平
能用总和除以个数求平均数
set.description: 理解平均数表示一组数的平均水平，会求几个数的平均数。
set.name: Mean

set.reason: The two endpoints substantially repeat the same sum/count procedure and average-level meaning. This is curricular review, not a substantive new content dependency between separate concepts.
set.scope: Elementary arithmetic-mean experience before a later treatment of the same concept

set.reason: Signed rational addition is the operation needed to sum observations such as negative temperatures; the rejected mixed-power workflow is the wrong endpoint. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
set.scope: Summing rational-valued observations when computing their arithmetic mean

set.reason: The mean criterion divides the total by the count; it does not require powers or a complete mixed-power evaluation procedure. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
set.scope: Dividing the rational total by the positive observation count in an arithmetic mean

set.reason: Explaining weights changes how observations contribute to an average level; the ordinary mean supplies that averaging meaning, restricted to this interpretation component.
set.scope: weighted mean as generalization of arithmetic mean

set.reason: A quantified statement is judged true or false over its domain; proposition meaning is the relevant prerequisite, not necessary/sufficient-condition classification. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
set.scope: Determining truth of quantified propositions

set.reason: Subtracting the same real quantity preserves order, giving exactly the sign-of-difference criterion. This requires the common-addend order property, not mastery of all negative-multiplier transformations.
set.scope: Translating A>B into the equivalent difference condition A-B>0

set.description: 理解平均数是反映一组数据集中趋势的统计量，会求算术平均数。
